reasons.text: The label is legible and shows model PA-10, which is a recalled model.
The claimed purchase date of 2020-09-05 is before the program's sale window (2021-06-01 to 2023-11-30), so the purchase does not qualify.
The retailer Sam Ash is on the list of sellers and the date code 2126 is in the recalled range, but these do not cure the purchase being outside the window.
